description: Maximum empirical mean cross-entropy across groups present in the input; a class-index specialization of the generic task loss in paper §2 Eq. (4), implemented in src/topologies/implementations/losses/group_dro.py:4-69. Reduction 'none' returns group means sorted by group ID, while 'sum' sums those means.

examples.title: Train a classifier with worst-group risk

name: Group DRO cross-entropy

parameters.additional parameters: **params accepts only group_ids; unsupported keys raise ValueError
parameters.group_ids: required one-dimensional tensor with one integer-valued group ID per example; group means are sorted by ID
parameters.ignore_index: integer target to exclude before group aggregation, or None; all-ignored batches raise ValueError
parameters.logits_or_prediction: finite floating-point class logits with shape [B, C], B greater than zero and C at least two
parameters.reduction: none returns means for observed groups sorted by ID, mean returns the maximum group mean, or sum totals group means (default mean)
parameters.targets: one-dimensional class indices with shape [B]; integral floating-point indices are accepted
